Definition: middle voice from G575 and μάσσω (to squeeze, knead, smear); to scrape away:--wipe off.
BiblicalUsage: Once, in the seventy's commission. Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you — the disciples shake the town's dust from their feet as a testimony, and still add that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
TheologicalSignificance: One sharp gesture, and the warning is plain: a town that refuses the messengers keeps its dust, and loses the kingdom.
